Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the chandelier move or act, that creature must succeed on a DC 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that the chandelier is animate.

traits.name: Fiery Aura
traits.descriptionHtml: Any creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of the chandelier takes 7 (2d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.descriptionHtml: The chandelier makes three Chain attacks, three Lamp attacks, or a combination thereof.

actions.name: Chain
actions.descriptionHtml: mw +7 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be pulled into an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the chandelier.

actions.name: Lamp
actions.descriptionHtml: mw +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 (2d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 13 (3d8) fire damage.

actions.name: Blazing Vortex (Recharge 5)
actions.descriptionHtml: Each creature within 20 feet of the chandelier and not behind Cover must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or take 36 (8d8) fire damage and have the blinded condition until the start of the chandelier's next turn.

legendaryActions.description: The creature can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: Windfall casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 23):

atWill.name: Light
atWill.components: V, M (a firefly or phosphorescent moss)

1.name: Hold Monster
1.components: V, S, M (a straight piece of iron)

3e.name: Shatter
3e.components: V, S, M (a chip of mica)

3e.name: Unseen Servant
3e.components: V, S, M (a bit of string and of wood)

traits.name: Dazzling Visage
traits.descriptionHtml: A brilliant array of chromatic colors emanates from Windfall, causing attack rolls against her to have disadvantage. This trait ceases to function while Windfall has the incapacitated condition or has a speed of 0.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.descriptionHtml: If Windfall fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.descriptionHtml: Windfall wears an iridescent magic coat that was tailored specifically for her and imbued with Tiamat's power. When she dies, the coat functions as a Robe of Scintillating Colors.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.descriptionHtml: Windfall makes two Chromatic Rapier attacks and uses Dragon's Fury once.

actions.name: Chromatic Rapier
actions.descriptionHtml: mw +14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 (1d8 + 7) piercing damage plus 21 (6d6) acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison damage (Windfall's choice).

actions.name: Dragon's Fury
actions.descriptionHtml: Windfall targets one creature she can see within 60 feet of herself and unleashes a burst of magical ire. The target must make a DC 23 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 36 (8d8) psychic damage and has the frightened condition until the start of Windfall's next turn. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage only.

bonusActions.name: Stunning Scintillation (Recharge 5)
bonusActions.descriptionHtml: Windfall emits an overwhelming array of colors from her coat. Each creature within 30 feet of Windfall that can see her must succeed on a DC 23 Constitution saving throw or have the stunned condition until the start of Windfall's next turn.

legendaryActions.description: The creature can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below.

entries.name: Deft Dance
entries.descriptionHtml: Windfall moves up to her speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

entries.name: Dragon's Flare
entries.descriptionHtml: Windfall flares with multicolored flames and targets a creature she can see within 30 feet of herself. The target must make a DC 23 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 26 (4d12) damage of a type chosen by Windfall: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage.

entries.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 2 Actions)
entries.descriptionHtml: Windfall uses Spellcasting.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting (Psionics)
spellcasting.header: The githyanki's innate spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components:

3e.name: Jump
3e.components: V, S, M (a grasshopper's hind leg)

3e.name: Nondetection
3e.components: V, S, M (a pinch of diamond dust worth 25+ GP, which the spell consumes)

1e.name: Plane Shift
1e.components: V, S, M (a forked, metal rod worth 250+ GP and attuned to a plane of existence)

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.descriptionHtml: The githyanki makes two silver greatsword attacks.

actions.name: Silver Greatsword
actions.descriptionHtml: mw +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) psychic damage. This is a magic weapon attack. On a critical hit against a target in an astral body (as with the astral projection spell), the githyanki can cut the silvery cord that tethers the target to its material body, instead of dealing damage.
